title: Tail Lights
artist: 東都ナイト・アンサンブル
caption: 1980s neo-noir film score, instrumental. Slow, sultry alto saxophone melody over warm analog synthesizer pads, round fretless bass, electric piano with chorus effect, soft electronic drums with a gated reverb snare. Lonely, seductive, a city seen through a rain-streaked windscreen at night. Polished, spacious 1980s studio sound. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration C).
